decision.rationale: The disputed transaction TXN-007934 is on card CRD-000164 for 112.68 EUR. It posted on 2026-08-12, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-28, 77 days later. That is within the 120-day time limit. Authorisation AUTH-008140 shows the card's chip was used at the terminal (entry mode CHIP), the PIN was entered correctly (pin_verified true), the payment was approved and the fraud flag was not set. This means the card and the PIN were both present. The card also has two earlier purchases at the same merchant, MER-000048: TXN-007933 on 2026-06-11 and TXN-007932 on 2026-06-26. The statement that the card never left the cardholder supports the view that the card was present. Under unauthorised-chip-and-pin, a chip transaction with the PIN verified and no fraud flag counts as made by the cardholder, so the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: Our records show this payment was made with your card's chip and the correct PIN at the merchant's terminal, and our fraud checks did not mark it as suspicious. Your card was also used at the same merchant twice in June 2026. Under our policy, a chip-and-PIN payment like this counts as made by the cardholder, so we cannot treat it as unauthorised.
